name: Minccino
officialSummary: Minccino is meticulous about cleanliness. It sweeps its surroundings with its soft tail, keeps that tail carefully groomed, and even uses tail-to-tail contact to greet others. After a particularly messy day, it may spend a long time washing its tail.
description: A tidy Normal-type Pokémon. You saw one polishing a lamp at the Portico Hotel.

observations.text: You saw a Minccino polishing the Portico Hotel's reception counter and a brass lamp with its tail.

name: Machoke
officialSummary: Machoke has an exceptionally strong, well-trained body and can handle loads far beyond what most people could lift. Its power-save belt helps keep that strength under control. Many Machoke willingly take on demanding physical work as part of their regular training.
description: A powerful Fighting-type Pokémon. You saw one guiding luggage carts at Lezano Harbor.

observations.text: You saw a Machoke in a crew vest directing luggage carts through Lezano Harbor.

name: Wingull
officialSummary: Wingull spends much of its life near the sea, gliding on rising air currents with its long, narrow wings. It nests on steep coastal cliffs and carries food in its beak; some Wingull are known to hide food and interesting objects near their nesting places.
description: A coastal Water- and Flying-type Pokémon. You saw one visiting your hotel balcony.

observations.text: You saw a curious Wingull investigate your water glass on the Portico Hotel balcony.

name: Wattrel
officialSummary: Wattrel lives along coastlines and makes its nests on coastal cliffs. Wind passing through its wings helps it generate electricity, which it can use to stun prey while hunting over the sea. Its connection to the wind is central to both its flight and its feeding habits.
description: An Electric- and Flying-type coastal bird Pokémon. You saw one at Lezano Harbor or the Salt and Thyme.

observations.text: You watched a Wattrel ride the breeze after taking off from a post in Lezano Harbor.
You looked up a Wattrel while it was tangled in the Salt and Thyme's awning, delaying your help.
You saved a note about a Wattrel that became tangled in the café awning and was later freed.
